ck_production_enablements_revocation.name: ck_production_enablements_revocation
ck_production_enablements_revocation.value: ("production_enablements"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "production_enablements"."revoked_at" is null and "production_enablements"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("production_enablements"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "production_enablements"."revoked_at" is not null and length("production_enablements"."revocation_reason") between 1 and 300)

ck_certificates_revoked.name: ck_certificates_revoked
ck_certificates_revoked.value: ("certificates"."status" = 'REVOKED') = ("certificates"."revoked_at" is not null) and ("certificates"."status" <> 'REVOKED' or "certificates"."wrapped_dek" is null)

ck_certificates_metadata.name: ck_certificates_metadata
ck_certificates_metadata.value: "certificates"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'REPLACED') or ("certificates"."thumbprint_sha256" is not null and "certificates"."not_after" is not null and "certificates"."subject_cnpj" is not null)

uq_service_invoices_external_reference.name: uq_service_invoices_external_reference
uq_service_invoices_external_reference.where: "service_invoices"."external_reference" is not null and "service_invoices"."status" not in ('REJECTED', 'FAILED')
